items.title: Keycloak: potential bypass of brute force protection
items.summary: A vulnerability was found in Keycloak. This flaw allows attackers to bypass brute force protection by exploiting the timing of login attempts. By initiating multiple login requests simultaneously, attackers can exceed the configured limits for failed attempts before the system locks them out. This timing loophole enables attackers to make more guesses at passwords than intended, potentially compromising account…

items.title: Keycloak-services: keycloak admin rest api: improper access control leads to sensitive role metadata information disclosure
items.summary: A flaw was found in Keycloak Admin REST (Representational State Transfer) API. This vulnerability allows information disclosure of sensitive role metadata via insufficient authorization checks on the /admin/realms/{realm}/roles endpoint.

items.title: Kernel: dccp: conntrack out-of-bounds read in nf conntrack dccp packet()
items.summary: An out-of-bounds read vulnerability was found in Netfilter Connection Tracking (conntrack) in the Linux kernel. This flaw allows a remote user to disclose sensitive information via the DCCP protocol.

items.title: Kernel: kvm: svm: improper check in svm set x2apic msr interception allows direct access to host x2apic msrs
items.summary: A flaw was found in KVM. An improper check in svm set x2apic msr interception() may allow direct access to host x2apic msrs when the guest resets its apic, potentially leading to a denial of service condition.

items.title: Kernel: ksmbd memory exhaustion denial-of-service vulnerability
items.summary: A flaw exists within the Linux kernel's handling of new TCP connections. The issue results from the lack of memory release after its effective lifetime. This vulnerability allows an unauthenticated attacker to create a denial of service condition on the system.

items.title: Cri-o: cri-o: checkpoint restore path traversal in deleted.files allows host filesystem deletion
items.summary: A flaw was found in CRI-O. An attacker with access to the kubelet or CRI-O socket can exploit a path traversal vulnerability in the checkpoint restore functionality. This allows the attacker to delete arbitrary files and directories on the host filesystem during a checkpoint restore operation. The vulnerability arises because the system processes entries from checkpoint archive metadata without validating that the…

items.title: Org.keycloak.services.resources.admin: keycloak: limited administrator can retrieve sensitive user attributes via admin api
items.summary: A flaw was found in Keycloak Admin API. This vulnerability allows an administrator with limited privileges to retrieve sensitive custom attributes via the /unmanagedAttributes endpoint, bypassing User Profile visibility settings.

items.title: Kernel: netfilter: potential slab-out-of-bound access due to integer underflow
items.summary: An array indexing vulnerability was found in the netfilter subsystem of the Linux kernel. A missing macro could lead to a miscalculation of the h- nets array offset, providing attackers with the primitive to arbitrarily increment/decrement a memory buffer out-of-bound. This issue may allow a local user to crash the system or potentially escalate their privileges on the system.

The vulnerability exists in the implementation of the file name reconstruction function, which is responsible for reading file name entries from a directory index and merging file name parts belonging to one file into a single long file name. items.title: Kernel: xfrm: out-of-bounds read in xfrm state filter match()
items.summary: A flaw was found in the XFRM subsystem in the Linux kernel. The specific flaw exists within the processing of state filters, which can result in a read past the end of an allocated buffer. This flaw allows a local privileged (CAP NET ADMIN) attacker to trigger an out-of-bounds read, potentially leading to an information disclosure.

items.title: soapbar: verify envelope bsp accepts an unauthenticated embedded certificate (signature forgery / authentication bypass)
